name: EPIC 249617620
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 15.3 solar radii and 1.26 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249617620 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.27616 (16th-84th percentiles 14.283002-16.430253), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249617620 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5478.828125 (16th-84th percentiles 5206.09375-5766.015625), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 5,479 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.26 solar masses and 15.3 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,704 K at its surface.
